item.title: Real Madrid Stays In Title Race As Deflected Goal Gives Late Win In Vigo
item.description: But Federico Valverde: Real Madrid stayed in the La Liga title race on Friday night thanks to a stroke of luck that earned a 2-1 win away to Celta Vigo.

item.title: T20 WC: 8 Wins In 7 Matches -- India's Road To Final
item.description: T20 World Cup: Defending champions India will face New Zealand in the final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 to be played at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday.

item.title: Bayern Cruises Past Monchengladbach Despite Heavy Rotation
item.description: Coach Vincent Kompany: Bayern Munich eased to a 4-1 victory over Borussia Monchengladbach in the Bundesliga at the Allianz Arena on Friday, overcoming several absences and heavy rotation to take control of the match.

item.title: T20 WC: India Vs New Zealand Head-to-head Record And Last Five Matches Results Ahead Of Final
item.description: T20 World Cup: An upbeat Indian team will square off against a strong New Zealand side in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup final at the Narendra Modi Stadium on Sunday, in what will be a second ICC tournament summit clash between the two teams in the past one year after the Champions Trophy final that took place a year ago, on March 9, 2025.

item.title: Mexico Steps Up World Cup Security
item.description: Jalisco New Generation Cartel: Mexico will deploy around 100,000 security personnel to ensure public safety during this year's FIFA World Cup, President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Saturday.

item.title: T20 WC: 5 Wins, Two Defeats And A Tie -- New Zealand's Road To Final
item.description: T20 World Cup: New Zealand are one step away from completing an impressive redemption story at the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026.

item.title: Indian Wells: Sinner, Zverev Advance, Fucsovics Stuns Musetti In Opener
item.description: Italian Matteo Berrettini: World No. 2 Jannik Sinner began his bid for a maiden title at the Indian Wells with a commanding performance in the opener, sweeping aside Czech qualifier Dalibor Svrcina 6-1, 6-1 in just over an hour.

item.title: T20 WC: A Glimpse At All India Vs New Zealand Clashes
item.description: T20 World Cup Final: India, as hosts and defending champions, with recent bilateral wins over their opponents, might be slight favourites for Sunday’s ICC Men's T20 World Cup Final against New Zealand at the Narendra Modi Stadium.

item.title: Indian Wells: Sabalenka Powers Into Rd 2, Gauff, Osaka Advance After Tense Battles
item.description: Victoria Jimenez Kasintseva: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka made a confident start to her campaign at the Indian Wells, defeating Japanese qualifier Himeno Sakatsume 6-4, 6-2 in the opener.
